runs.name: Pinnacle West Capital Corporation; NYSE PNW, Arizona, 10-K filer; holding company of Arizona Public Service, operator and part owner of Palo Verde
runs.entry: The v5 re-run order at the operator's word ("Yes start with those"), interactive dispatch under the canonical brief, five analysts in parallel (NRG, OGE, PAM, PCG, PNW), lock held by the main session; the brief's one departure is the repository path after the move of 2026-10-25. Price **$105.88** (2026-10-23, aggregator, flagged) x **121,197,234 shares** (one class, 10-Q cover at 2026-07-28; about 13.55M forward-sale shares signed and not issued, beside) = cap **$12,832M**; sovereign **5.33%** (Treasury 30-year, 2026-10-23). Q1 IN (APS essentially all of earnings, one segment, retail 95% of revenue; rate base $8.87B to $10.5B to $12.5B over three cases; 10-K FY2025 `0000764622-26-000011`). Q2 IN on the regulator's exception, carried to Q3 (2016 case settled at 10.0%; 2019 case ordered 8.70% with a 20bp penalty and a $215.5M disallowance in 2021, reversed in 2023 after the Court of Appeals, 8.9%; 2022 case 9.55% against 10.25% asked; 2025 case pending, 10.70% asked). Q3 against (the decade's added capital earned about 5.8% on added equity, 3.3% unlevered after tax). Q4 against (an annual EPS outlook published; owner cash after all spending negative in nine of ten years). Q5 OUT on integrity, on doubt: federal grand jury subpoenas over the 2014 Arizona Corporation Commission elections (FY2019 10-K, the matter closed); the company fought a commissioner's subpoenas for its political-spending records from 2016 to 2020; the remedy, a promise not to take part in Commission elections "during his tenure", was the former CEO's and lapsed with his tenure on 2025-03-31, renewed in no filing read; the current website policy (read through a fetch tool, flagged) bars contributions to candidates and reportedly says nothing of independent expenditures, the 2014 channel. The analyst records that a reader confining Q5 to the officers now in office could close it IN; the box would stay OUT at Q7. COMPUTATION, NOT A CLEARANCE: equity-only owner cash after maintenance $441M a year (2021 to 2025), after all spending -$538M; range **$68.2 to $99.6 a share equity-only (central, regulated utility)**, growth cut to the company's own sales growth of 8.85% under (f), growth spending $1,065M in year one to $2,288M in year ten, debt credit $698M a year at a 60.0% cap (own long-term-debt share, no allowed share stated); fair price **$36.45 equity-only** (all-equity -$49.8); no case earns the floor (3.43% and 5.11% at the price). Peers (ten-year ROE, own filings): PNW 9.5%, IDA 9.5%, POR 8.1%, XEL 10.4%, TEP 9.3%. Tooling defects reported: `tools/run.py` capital spending gross of customer contributions and the Palo Verde lessor lines, and 2023's current maturities counted twice. Dispatcher's check: check_framework PASS; pathspec commits, own paths only (last `fbc02fcb`); 61 ids clean (the analyst's check). Contamination declared: names in the auto-loaded map and one `git status` path; none opened. Position note filled at the fold: not held. No alert (closed at Q5).
runs.narr: OUT at Q5 on integrity: a utility that spent to elect its own regulator in 2014, fought the records subpoenas for four years, and whose remedy was one CEO's personal promise that lapsed when he retired in 2025. Computation only: range $68.2 to $99.6 equity-only vs $105.88, fair $36.45; it would have closed OUT at Q7 anyway. The dividend is paid from new debt and shares.
